verdicts.typography: Flawless Swiss-style hierarchy: bold display headings, restrained mono uppercase micro-labels, generous line-height, and disciplined tracking. No orphans, no cramped text.
verdicts.color: Strict single-accent discipline maintained throughout. Near-black on white with consistent red accent usage. Accessible contrast. No off-brand colors or visual noise.
verdicts.layout: Impeccable grid alignment to max-w container. Consistent whitespace rhythm and padding. Hairline borders are intact with clean joints. Footer correctly pinned at document bottom.
verdicts.components: Publication-grade component quality. Matrix table shows correct sticky first column behavior (with functional shadow in scrolled state), clear mark legend, and properly distinguished final column. Accordion affordances and stat strip are crisp and professional.
verdicts.responsive: Flawless execution across all breakpoints and modes. Mobile layout (390px) maintains perfect typographic hierarchy, vertical rhythm, and container integrity with zero overflow or text clipping. The wide matrix table implements a robust horizontal scroll with a correctly pinned sticky first column and distinct shadow layering upon scroll. Dark mode demonstrates a meticulously consistent palette, preserving the signature red accent and ensuring high-contrast readability for all UI elements, including table grids and navigation.
